parameters.question: Compare the chi-square test results for chromosome-level CpG-site uniformity, requiring the chi-square statistic to agree within 1% relative absolute error and degrees of freedom to match exactly; accept a reported p-value of 0 when the true value is below floating-point precision, and allow differing column order and extra columns.
